epic.summary: [makato] Agentic Orchestration — autonomous control plane for makato build/plan workflows
epic.objective: Add autonomous orchestration to makato: plan → build → review → merge with minimal human in the loop, using R1 contracts, kill-switches, and resumable workflow state

stories.summary: [makato-orchestrate] feat: CI failure + human-review outer fix loops in PO-agent (GAP-010)
stories.title: CI failure + human-review outer fix loops in PO-agent
stories.description: After a PR is created, two failure modes require an outer fix cycle: (1) CI fails — gh pr checks returns failure — requiring the coder to be re-dispatched with the CI log output; (2) a reviewer requests changes — gh pr view --json reviewDecision returns CHANGES_REQUESTED — requiring the address-PR-comments skill to be re-run. Without these loops, the PO-agent job ends at PR creation and a human must handle CI red and review cycles manually.
acceptance_criteria: PO-agent polls gh pr checks after PR creation (30s initial delay, then every 60s up to 10 polls).

On CI failure: PO-agent fetches failed-job log via gh run view --log-failed, appends to workflow-state lessons_learned[], dispatches coder.md with failure output as additional context, increments outer_iteration.
HALT-008 (outer_iterations >= 3) fires before re-dispatch — PO-agent labels the PR needs-human-review and stops.
PO-agent polls gh pr view --json reviewDecision every 300s (configurable) while PR is open.
On CHANGES_REQUESTED: PO-agent calls build-address-pr-comments in --autonomous mode, increments human_review_cycles.
HALT-010 (human_review_cycles >= MAX_HUMAN_REVIEW_CYCLES, default 2) fires — PO-agent labels PR needs-human-review and stops.
workflow-state schema fields outer_iteration, human_review_cycles, github_pr_number are consumed correctly (defined in GAP-003 / #26).
stories.notes: Uses gh pr checks --json name,state,conclusion for CI status polling. gh run view --log-failed for extracting failure context. build-address-pr-comments called in --autonomous mode. Lesson-learned append uses workflow-state append-lesson. Out of scope: handling concurrent review threads from multiple reviewers in a single cycle; auto-merging the PR after approval.
